fabricated_details: Initial diagnosis at 10:35 AM identifying a jammed wire spool

No further issues reported during the remainder of the shift

rationale: The report captures all facts from the very brief input, but massively hallucinates a vast amount of detail, timelines, production losses, follow-up actions, and recommendations that were never stated. Severities and classifications are assigned rather than marked unknown where details are absent. While structured well and easy to read, the severe level of invention makes it a major accuracy hazard.
